_comment: 性格初读卡静态模板库英文版（PRD §5.19.2 P1-B01 / 架构方案 §二 M1）。与 zh.json 同 key 结构；断言 = 复述并放大用户对快问的自述，静态直出、不经 LLM。

questions.text: When a friend gets on your nerves, you usually...

options.text: hold it in until it overflows
step back and raise it after the heat passes

questions.text: Facing something you're unsure about, you...

options.text: pack your schedule until there's no gap left
think it out loud with someone

questions.text: What kind of time is late night for you?

options.text: the only time you allow yourself to slow down
the day going through your head again
when your thinking is clearest and your energy is real

conflict.speak_now: What matters to you deserves to be said: your move is to {option} — you don't let a misunderstanding sit overnight.
conflict.hold_in: Your move is to {option}, and the talking only happens once it can't be held any longer.
conflict.step_back: You don't talk at the peak of it — your move is to {option}.

uncertainty.keep_busy: When something is unsure, you {option} — the not-knowing gets no room.
uncertainty.list_out: When something is unsure, you {option} — you need a floor under it before you move.
uncertainty.talk_out: Your thoughts take shape as you speak, so you {option}.

night.slow_down: For you, late night is {option} — daytime rarely permits that.
night.replay: For you, late night is {option} — what you said, and what you didn't.
night.sharpest: You save the real work for {option}, while daytime often just idles.

summary_frame: You placed yourself in {persona}: {trait}. On this card that is not a conclusion, only the doorway you handed yourself.
closer: In 30 days you'll get your first Monthly Story — by then it will know you better than today does.
fillers: You haven't written a single record yet, but you already started. Write one, and it slowly turns into your own words.
You say more to yourself than you ever say out loud. Write it down, and it stays right here waiting.

personas.INTP: unable to let go of what you haven't figured out
personas.ENTJ: setting the direction first, feelings after
personas.ENTP: asking "what if it isn't?" from the other side
personas.INFJ: reading the room before you speak
personas.INFP: measuring things by your own scale
personas.ENFJ: checking on everyone else's state first
personas.ENFP: lit up by the possibility first
personas.ISTJ: letting what you've done do the talking
personas.ISFJ: remembering the details other people mentioned
personas.ESTJ: only at ease once things are in order
personas.ESFJ: making everyone in the room comfortable
personas.ISTP: taking it apart to see how it works
personas.ISFP: not explaining yourself, just showing it
personas.ESTP: getting in and judging while moving
personas.ESFP: valuing the lived moment over the plan
